desk_read: Yesterday featured a dominant wave of new shorts and long liquidation across several key asset classes. WTI Crude Oil saw active volume at 1.4x its 20-day average alongside an open interest increase of +17.6k contracts and a price drop of -0.38%, reading as new shorts entering a backwardated curve. Brent experienced heavy long liquidation with total open interest plummeting -29.7k contracts (-19.7%) on volume of 1.2x the 20-day average. Meanwhile, equity indices like Nasdaq 100 showed short covering as total open interest fell -4.9k contracts (-1.6%) alongside a price gain of +0.63% in contango. Gold also attracted fresh selling pressure with open interest rising +7.9k contracts (+2.1%) and a price decline of -0.74%.
